5056095713238.sourceDescription:
Bring the warmth of Christmas into your home with our Pre-Lit Norway Spruce Christmas Tree. Full, natural-looking foliage and warm white LED lights create a welcoming centrepiece, ready for treasured ornaments and festive finishing touches. Available in heights, 6ft and 7ft.

This Norway Spruce has a beautifully full silhouette and a blend of realistic PE and PVC tips adding texture and depth, providing an abundant setting for your decorations.

The lights are already fitted, so you can enjoy bringing your Christmas decorating ideas to life. Choose a steady glow for cosy evenings, a gentle slow fade or a little twinkle for festive gatherings. There are 8 multifunction settings to explore, with mains power supplied through a low voltage transformer.

Hinged branches fold down for assembly, while the included folding metal stand provides a practical base. Gently separate the branches and arrange the tips to reveal the tree's full shape, then dress it with delicate neutrals, traditional reds and golds or colourful family favourites.

Features:
 Light functions: 8 settings, including steady glow, twinkle and slow fade
 Power supply: Mains powered with a low voltage transformer
 Realistic mixed PE and PVC foliage
 Traditional Christmas tree shape
 Hinged branch construction
 Folding metal stand included
 For indoor use only

Take time to separate and shape the branches after assembly to achieve a full, balanced appearance.
Height: 6ft / 1.8m
Diameter: 130cm
Tip count: 1704 (1022 PE and 682 PVC)
Lights: 350 warm white LEDs
Guarantee - 1 year
Tool free assembly
With stand

Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details

Durable construction combines plastic foliage with a sturdy metal frame for stability.
Versatile green finish adds festive detail to any home Christmas display arrangement.

Step into a world of twinkle and enchantment with the 150cm Slim Black Microdot Starburst Tree – the ultimate centrepiece for those who like their festivities sprinkled with a dash of magic! With a mesmerising 708 warm white bulbs, this strikingly slender tree dazzles like a constellation plucked straight from the night sky. But wait, there’s more: 20% of those bulbs have a twinkling superpower, orchestrating a subtle light show that gently shimmers and winks at you, adding a playful sparkle to any room. The elegant black silhouette gives a modern, chic vibe, effortlessly blending with contemporary décor while standing out just enough to make a statement. An 8-metre lead length means you can position this dazzling beauty almost anywhere your heart fancies – from the hallway to the living room or even beside your favourite reading nook. Rated IP20 for indoor use, it’s powered by a safe, efficient transformer, so you can sit back, relax, and let your home bask in a warm, starry glow. Why settle for ordinary lights when you can have a celestial spectacle?
Guarantee - 1 year

Transform your home into a festive wonderland with the 180cm prelit green, red, and gold pop up tree – the effortless showstopper that makes holiday decorating a pure joy. Standing tall and radiant at 180cm, this tree arrives adorned with 180 warm white bulbs, casting a cosy, inviting glow that instantly lifts the mood. Its lush green PVC branches, accented with shimmering red and gold, bring a classic yet vibrant touch to your celebrations. With eight multifunctional lighting options, you can set the perfect ambience, from twinkling wonder to a gentle glow, tailored to every moment. The sturdy plastic base and robust copper wiring ensure stability and longevity, while the ingenious pop-up design means assembly is a breeze – simply pop it up, plug it in, and bask in the seasonal cheer. Whether you’re short on time or space, or simply crave convenience without sacrificing style, this tree is the ultimate centrepiece, inspiring joy and togetherness throughout the festive season.

5031470300838.sourceDescription:
Create a magical winter forest look with the Pre-Lit Valmorel Flocked Artificial Christmas Tree. Available in 5ft, 6ft, 7ft, and 8ft sizes, it features a blend of PVC and pine needles with a heavily flocked finish for an enchanting wintry look.

COLOUR SWITCH LEDS & LIGHT EFFECTS: Change from warm white to multi-coloured LEDs to set the perfect festive mood. From soft fades and twinkles to stunning, colour-changing bursts, choose from a variety of light effects, with a built-in memory function remembering your last setting.

MAINS POWERED WITH BUILT-IN TIMER: Mains powered with a 5m green cable for flexible display, the tree features a built-in timer function for hassle-free festive lighting. Once activated, the LEDs automatically illuminate at the same time each evening before switching off six hours later.

HINGED BRANCH CONSTRUCTION: Designed with hinged branches for easy assembly, the tree slots together while the branches drop naturally into place. Gentle fluffing helps create a bushier shape, allowing you to spend less time assembling and more time admiring your display.

STURDY GREEN METAL STAND: Every tree includes a sturdy green metal stand with silver eyebolts for secure attachment and stable display all season long. Designed to blend naturally with the foliage, it also features rubber feet to help protect hard floors from marks and scratches.

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Gold and Red. Product measurements: length 25 cm, width 25 cm, height 7 cm. Product weight: 0.55 kg. Quantity: 40 pack.
40-pack of festive gold and red plastic baubles featuring a sparkling glitter finish for eye-catching tree decoration.
Each ornament includes a hanging cord, allowing for easy suspension on branches or integration into coordinated seasonal displays.
Lightweight design ensures convenient handling and effortless storage, making it simple to organise and redecorate throughout the season.
The textured glitter surface adds visual depth and pairs effectively with plain finishes to create a balanced and elegant Christmas aesthetic.

Easter Decorations
These Easter decorations add a decorative detail to the chosen display.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Wood. Stated size: 30 x 28.6 x 0.6 cm. Product weight: 0.15 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Crafted from wood with a hanging cord for easy display.
Compact dimensions of 30 x 28.6 cm suit various home settings.

Versatile seasonal ornament to enhance Easter decorations.

Light up trees are a clever way to add festive height and impact without the mess of a real tree. Use one as a centrepiece, place a pair either side of a doorway, or combine different sizes to create a glowing forest effect in the garden or a large room. A show-stopping alternative to a traditional tree, it brings instant festive impact with none of the needles, and can be enjoyed year after year. 5096042277338.baseName: Christmas garland - Seasonal hanging garland - Realistic pine needles and hanging loops for stair and mantel displays - Green
5096042277338.variantName: Christmas garland - Seasonal hanging garland - Realistic pine needles and hanging loops for stair and mantel displays - Green
5096042277338.sourceDescription:
Dense PE needles give this garland a soft, full outline along its approximately 1.5 m length. A wire core allows gradual bends and the integrated loops provide hanging points, useful when shaping the greenery round a doorway. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change.

A garland lets you carry one theme across a length of the room. It can pick up the line of a shelf, a stair rail or a doorway, tying together different parts of a display without needing several separate decorations at each point.

A shallow drape uses less of the available length and gives the greenery a cleaner line along the edge of a shelf. Measure the route you want the garland to follow, including the curves or dips along the way. A length laid straight across a mantel reaches further than the same length arranged in a series of deep swags.

Viewed from across the room, a few gentle curves usually show the design more clearly than many tight bends. Lay the garland along its route before securing it and check how the ends fall from the main display. Carry a colour from the garland into a small cluster of ornaments at either end. Repeating just one shade helps the whole display feel connected without adding so much decoration that the original details disappear.

On a staircase, plan the fixing points so the handrail stays easy to grip. Follow the line of the stairs from below as you arrange the length, checking that the lowest sections stay clear of the steps. Leave enough material at each end to finish the line neatly, particularly if the garland turns a corner.

When you take the display down, release each fixing in turn and support the loose length as you go. Store it in broad curves, with enough space around the decorative details to avoid flattening them.
Realistic pine needle design with integrated hanging loops for easy display on stairs and mantels.
Flexible wire core allows gradual bending to shape the garland around doorways and railings.
Durable polyethylene construction suitable for both indoor and outdoor seasonal decoration use.
Approximately 1.5 metres in length, providing ample coverage for various festive display arrangements.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor & outdoor use

5060899961238.sourceDescription:
Bring the festive spirit into your home with the SASONS Green Artificial Christmas Tree, crafted in a traditional Colorado Pine Spruce style. With 1000 thick, realistic tips, this tree provides a full and natural look, perfect for decorating with baubles, tinsel, and lights.

This artificial Christmas tree features a convenient three-section design for straightforward assembly. Simply connect the bottom, middle and top sections in order. The branches are already attached to each section, eliminating the need to fit individual branches. Once assembled, gently spread and shape the flexible wire branches and tips to create a full, natural-looking Christmas tree.
The sturdy metal stand ensures stability, while the easy slot-together design makes assembly and storage simple. Standing at 180cm tall, it’s the ideal size for both homes and offices, offering a timeless centerpiece for your Christmas celebrations.

Reusable year after year, this artificial tree is a cost-effective and eco-friendly alternative to real trees – giving you the same festive charm without the mess of falling needles.
Traditional Christmas Look – Designed to resemble a full Colorado Pine Spruce with a classic festive appearance.
Perfect Sizes – 6Ft (180cm) tall, ideal for living rooms, offices, hallways, and festive displays.
Full & Lush Shape – 800 thick tips create a natural, bushy effect for hanging ornaments and lights.
Durable Metal Stand – Provides strength, balance, and long-lasting support for safe indoor use.
Easy to Assemble – 3 section artificial Christmas tree with pre-attached, manually shaped branches.
Reusable & Eco-Friendly – A high-quality artificial tree you can enjoy year after year.
Guarantee - 1 month
